context_refs.label: Context Refs
context_refs.description: Pointers to related entries. Bare timestamp = same spine. 'spine-name::timestamp' = cross-spine. Example value: ["2026-11-02T00:00:05.000000+00:00", "other-spine::2026-11-01T12:00:00.000000+00:00"]

context_summary.label: Context Summary
context_summary.description: Prewritten narrative explaining what the context_refs contribute to understanding this entry — so an agent doesn't have to synthesize them cold. Example: "See decision-log entry for why this approach was chosen and the review entry for its known limitations."
